title: Isoniazid
effect: Convulsions uncommon at conventional doses; overdose → severe, intractable seizures, coma and severe metabolic acidosis within 30 min–3 h
pearls: Gross overdose 80–150 mg/kg can be fatal; acute ingestion >80 mg/kg gets IV pyridoxine even if asymptomatic
Pyridoxine IV gram for gram equal to the isoniazid dose; amount unknown: 5 g (adult)
Symptomatic: give pyridoxine as a slow IV bolus over 3–5 min; asymptomatic with unknown amount: 5 g over 30–60 min
Seizures continue: repeat pyridoxine (rarely >10 g; maximum safe dose unknown); no response: diazepam
Phenytoin only with caution — isoniazid inhibits its metabolism
Isoniazid raises carbamazepine and phenytoin levels — check a carbamazepine level before starting; adjust the ASM dose
sources: Isoniazid tablets USP US prescribing information. Marlex; revised 9/2025 (user-supplied label)
